name: 現在地と地図の位置指定
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse component LH01-0006 現在地と地図の位置指定, two rows choosing current location or a point on a map.
Reference hierarchy: image1 ORIGINAL controls icon geometry, optical weight, proportions, alignment/spacing and fine anatomy; relevant source region x39 y398 width1104 height308. Image2 rough mock is secondary Japanese content and overall2row layout; its thin outline paperplane/pin and mint discs are inaccurate. Image3 approved bus is style only.
Reproduce original FIRST icon: compact SOLID filled navigation/location arrow pointing upper-right, with original concave tail, no hollow paper airplane or circle. SECOND icon: original SOLID filled map teardrop pin with a small white circular hole, no doubled outlined pin or surrounding disc. Match original optical sizes, row centering, left icon/text alignment and inset horizontal separator.
Text exact: first row "現在地を使用"; second row "地図上で選択". No other text or controls.
Accent decision: retain original blue current-position arrow #2176D9 as a meaningful geolocation cue distinct from manual pin; second pin consistent supporting slate #526173. Text ink #1D1D1D. This is a specific current-position meaning, not random icon coloring. No blue filled CTA, no green/mint discs, no invented selection check. Two white action rows on one rounded white surface, fine neutral outer border, quiet inset divider, faint soft downward shadow; pure-white #FFFFFF canvas. Compact readable Meiryo Regular14px/24px at logical390px width, tracking0, delicate normal weight, single-line labels. High-resolution flat frontal landscape3:1 with modest white margins. Do not include original search field, saved places, history, contacts, keyboard, app logos or device chrome.
reviewNotes: 原画面の塗りつぶし現在地矢印と穴のある地点ピン、2つの日本語行、ミント円の除去を視認。現在地だけの青は実位置の意味として保持し地点ピンはスレート。ただし原参照の本文位置から始まる区切り線が生成で全幅になったため細部修正。所有者承認・実装ではない。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
